description:
Emit a tracing::info! event with audit = true on every auth outcome in basic_auth_middleware. These events are the primary compliance evidence for HIPAA §164.312(b) and PCI-DSS Requirement 10.

## Audit event schema (all auth events)
  tracing::info!(
      audit         = true,
      event.type    = "auth.login_success" | "auth.login_failure" | "auth.no_credentials",
      auth.method   = "basic" | "bearer_token" | "oidc_jwt",
      username      = %attempted_username,  // empty string if not present in request
      source_ip     = %source_ip,
      "auth event",
  );

## Specific sites in basic_auth_middleware (server.rs ~line 94)

  1. OIDC JWT success (line ~122): event.type = auth.login_success, auth.method = oidc_jwt
  2. OIDC JWT failure (line ~125): event.type = auth.login_failure, auth.method = oidc_jwt
     (Note: this currently falls through to bearer token check — only emit if ALL auth paths fail)
  3. Bearer token success (line ~134): event.type = auth.login_success, auth.method = bearer_token
  4. Bearer token not found (line ~137): event.type = auth.login_failure, auth.method = bearer_token
  5. Bearer token DB error (line ~139): event.type = auth.login_failure, auth.method = bearer_token
     (do not include the DB error message in the audit event — that belongs in the existing tracing::error! call)
  6. Basic auth credentials missing (line ~160): event.type = auth.no_credentials
  7. Basic auth wrong password (line ~164): event.type = auth.login_failure, auth.method = basic
  8. Basic auth success (line ~167): event.type = auth.login_success, auth.method = basic

## What NOT to log
- The password or token value (obvious)
- The full Authorization header
- DB error messages (already logged separately by existing tracing::error! calls)
- OIDC intermediate failures that fall through to the next auth method — only log a failure
  if the request is ultimately rejected, to avoid a failed-OIDC event immediately followed
  by a successful-bearer event which looks suspicious in audit logs

## Acceptance
- Integration test: correct credentials → audit event with event.type=auth.login_success emitted
- Integration test: wrong password → audit event with event.type=auth.login_failure emitted
- Integration test: missing Authorization header → audit event with event.type=auth.no_credentials emitted
- source_ip field is present and non-empty in all three cases
title: Add audit events to basic_auth_middleware for all auth outcomes
